label: Bluefin outlook
headline: Bluefin break sits under 8-ft seas — skip the long run
body:
Safety first: the outer and island waters (PZZ673, PZZ676) are under a small-craft advisory through Saturday afternoon and a gale watch Saturday evening into Monday morning. Even as it eases, Monday still shows NW 25–30 kt and seas 8–11 ft dropping to 7–9 out west, with 7–10 ft around San Nicolas.

Here's the bluefin problem. The only 64–68 °F break water is at Santa Rosa Flats on Monday (64.9 °F) — but that's under 8.2-ft seas and NW gusts to 12, right in the beat-up zone. By Tuesday the Flats warm to 70.7 °F, off the break entirely. Osborn (70.5/70.4) and San Nicolas (68.8/68.7) sit above the target all window, and San Nic is a 73-nm run into gale-watch seas. There's no day where the break water and a workable ride line up. Pass on the dedicated bluefin trip.

If you still want to fish, stay inside: backside Santa Cruz yellowtail Tuesday (72.8 °F, 3-ft seas) or the Goleta–Carpinteria halibut flats, calm both days.
